author: TeIq
content: **Pre-flight (architect).** Two integration test files: bus_kafka_integration.rs + bus_nats_integration.rs. Each spawns testcontainers broker, instantiates the bus backend, publishes N envelopes, subscribes, asserts bincode round-trip + bounded backpressure. Feature-gated. Kafka image takes 30-60s to come ready — wall-budget 60s. Module-level test-code allows for unwrap/expect.
